import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import io

# Load the dataset from the string
csv_data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# --- Data Preprocessing ---
# Fill missing 'Sleep Disorder' values with 'None' for clarity
df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None', inplace=True)

# Split 'Blood Pressure' into 'Systolic' and 'Diastolic' columns
df[['Systolic', 'Diastolic']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)

# --- Visualization ---
# Set a professional and clean style
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="viridis")

# Create a 2x2 grid for multiple plots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Factors Analysis', fontsize=20, weight='bold')

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs. Quality of Sleep, colored by Stress Level
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Quality of Sleep',
    y='Sleep Duration',
    hue='Stress Level',
    size='Physical Activity Level',
    sizes=(100, 400),
    palette='magma',
    ax=axes[0, 0],
    edgecolor='black',
    alpha=0.8
)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Quality vs. Duration by Stress & Activity', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Metrics')

# Plot 2: Distribution of Heart Rate by BMI Category and Sleep Disorder
sns.boxplot(
    data=df,
    x='BMI Category',
    y='Heart Rate',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    ax=axes[0, 1],
    order=['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Heart Rate by BMI and Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=12)

# Plot 3: Sleep Duration across different Occupations
sns.stripplot(
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Duration',
    y='Occupation',
    jitter=0.2,
    size=10,
    ax=axes[1, 0],
    hue='Occupation',
    legend=False
)
sns.boxplot(
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Duration',
    y='Occupation',
    ax=axes[1, 0],
    boxprops=dict(alpha=0.3),
    showfliers=False,
    whiskerprops=dict(alpha=0.3),
    capprops=dict(alpha=0.3)
)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration Across Occupations', fontsize=14)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)

# Plot 4: Relationship between Daily Steps and Systolic Blood Pressure
sns.regplot(
    data=df,
    x='Daily Steps',
    y='Systolic',
    ax=axes[1, 1],
    scatter_kws={'s': 100, 'alpha': 0.7, 'edgecolor': 'w'},
    line_kws={'color': '#c44e52', 'linewidth': 2.5}
)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Systolic Blood Pressure vs. Daily Steps', fontsize=14)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Systolic Blood Pressure (mmHg)', fontsize=12)

# Adjust layout to prevent overlap and save the figure
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.95])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
